metadata.case_name: JACKSON IVAN O'NEIL AMROL v. MARISOL RIVERA

injuries.description: fracture of the right temporal bone
source: He suffered a fracture of the right temporal bone and a traumatic perforation in his right ear as a result.
CT scan of the brain and skull showed right temporal bone fracture.
CT scans and Electroencephalograph (EEG) showed that the temporal bone fracture was in the process of healing.
injuries.icd_description: Fracture of other specified skull or facial bones

injuries.description: traumatic perforation of the right ear (traumatic drum perforation of the right ear)
source: He suffered a fracture of the right temporal bone and a traumatic perforation in his right ear as a result.
Examination by ENT surgeon Dr. Martin Pak revealed small traumatic perforation in Jack’s right ear and continuous oozing of fresh blood from the perforation.
The diagnosis was traumatic drum perforation of the right ear and right temporal bone fracture.
injuries.icd_description: Injury of middle or inner ear

manifestations.description: screaming for pain; holding his head and ear
blood gushing out from his ear / continuous oozing of fresh blood from the perforation
drowsy and nauseating (drowsy and nausea observed when examined at Canossa Hospital)
retained blood clot in the middle ear
impaired registration of memory (noticed and referred to neurologist)
difficulty in sleeping (reported by Jack's mother)
lethargic body condition (reported by Jack's mother)

treatments_received: packed right ear canal with normal saline soaked gauze (Discovery Bay Medical Centre)
referral to Canossa Hospital for further treatment
CT scan of the brain and skull
examination and cleansing by ENT surgeon; ear gently cleansed
follow-up consultations and monitoring until discharge
treatments_future: advised to attend follow-up with CT scan of the temporal bone at regular intervals until full recovery
seeking consultation from a private paediatric psychologist (as reported)

comparable_cases.injury_description: sustained a severe blow on the side of his head with his right eardrum damaged; resulted in tinnitus and moderate right-sided deafness
diagnosed to have suffered from Post Traumatic Distress Symptoms and subjective memory loss; aggravation of "Pervasive Developmental Disorders Not Otherwise Specified"
